beats: A crowned emoji stood in for a real king — kids read a label instead of recognizing a face.
Area was just a formula too — never a rectangle you could watch get built.
Now a history effect, built in Remotion, strings together real portraits chapter by chapter.
A matching geometry effect fills a rectangle with counted squares, then folds a triangle to prove it's half.
Seven rows of four squares, counted one by one, land on 28 square meters.
